name: Virtual Filesystem
shortDescription: PostgreSQL-backed virtual filesystem with session isolation, cross-session shared stores, POSIX-style operations, and Row Level Security.

rawRecord.name: Virtual Filesystem
rawRecord.short_description: PostgreSQL-backed virtual filesystem with session isolation, cross-session shared stores, POSIX-style operations, and Row Level Security.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides persistent file storage backed by PostgreSQL, decoupling filesystem operations from agent runtime so data survives process restarts and container recycling. Supports 11 POSIX-style tools including read, write, append, stat, ls, mkdir, rm, mv, glob, and grep, all with automatic session isolation. Cross-session named stores enable data sharing between agents and long-term memory, while optional Row Level Security enforces database-level session isolation for multi-tenant deployments.
